items.headline: Chabad seeks permit for religious use on Fremont Ave
items.summary: The September 30 Zoning Administrator agenda listed a use permit for Chabad of Sunnyvale to operate a religious assembly space inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, a site zoned for low-density residential use.

items.headline: Nvidia permitted for server rack installation on Holger Way
items.summary: A permit for an R&D Lab use type at 300 Holger Way covers an Nvidia rack installation, with a declared permit valuation of $1,664,913.

items.headline: Two large solar PV systems permitted on Coleman Avenue
items.summary: Commercial/Industrial permits were issued for PV systems at 555 Coleman Avenue and 561 Coleman Avenue, with declared permit valuations of $800,000 and $600,000 respectively.

items.headline: Potential fire-truck litigation listed on September 22 agenda
items.summary: The September 22 City Council agenda listed a closed-session legal consultation involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: September 22 agenda listed City Attorney appointment
items.summary: The September 22 closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: 408 new homes proposed on El Camino Real
items.summary: The City Council's September 22 agenda included a public hearing on prezoning, annexation, and a subdivision map to allow 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under CEQA.
